name: Codex
edited_files: .cwd as $cwd | .tool_input.command // "" | split("\n")[] | capture("^\\*\\*\\* (Add File|Update File|Move to): (?<path>.+)$") | .path | if startswith("/") then . else $cwd + "/" + . end
after_install: Restart running Codex sessions, then review and trust the hooks with /hooks: Codex skips hooks it has not been told to trust.
